name: Emanuele Agosta
role: UX and learning design at Tesla
bio: Emanuele is a product designer and Apple Certified Trainer. He was a senior design mentor at the Apple Developer Academy in Naples from 2019 to 2025, designing curriculum and mentoring 300+ international developers a year in UX/UI, product design, spatial computing, and accessibility. He now works on UX and learning design at Tesla in Amsterdam.
